input_order: Opaque case IDs in ascending order; each pass rotates the three arms by pass modulo three.
measurement: One separate process per arm and pass, including loading, all predictions and output. One outer process includes source preparation, checking and all waited workers. Collection checking has its own receipt.
opened_scope: Two invented table families cover all forms for controller checks. Fresh predictor calls remain zero during preparation.
repeat_policy: All 12 copies of each arm/case must have identical predictions, source selections, reasons and work counts. Quality metrics count each distinct case once.
score_policy: Use step 47 targets and benefit rule unchanged. Check source spans and reported arithmetic independently of the predictors. Malformed or incomplete collections retain a failed verification record.
source_preparation: Full cloud execution rebuilds all cases from the fixed report bytes, then checks every target with the published independent JavaScript arithmetic checker.
